NEET INTEL DAILY TIMECARD PROJECT Gallery

← Back to index

The NEET INTEL DAILY TIMECARD PROJECT is a set of daily timecards of transcribed Emergency Action Messages (EAMs) and/or Force Direction Messages (FDMs) broadcast by the US military over the High Frequency Global Communications System (HFGCS). The timecards are combined with the musical output of overseas (Korean, Japanese, and Chinese) entertainment industries for significant trends in military and musical activity.

A mirror of the project is maintained on the Internet Archive.

Days
YYMMDD
a date. Partials work: 2501 = January 2025; - matches any digit: --06 = every June, ----01 = every 1st
C###
days with an EAM of that length: C120; C32,27 = days with all of them
G#
days with that group: G2; G23 = both 2 and 3
Messages
g2c43
one message with that group and length; flags and a time mix in: g2c75mtf, g2car, g2dir@21
@0909
±10 min; @09 = that hour, @0909~30 = ±30 min, @0900-0930 = a range
g1mtf
G1 MORE TO FOLLOW sets; plain mtf leaves G1 out
charlieforce
a named FORCE, regioncharlie a named REGION; put it last when mixing: g2charlieforce@14
a>b
message b within 15 min after message a
a~b
either order
~N
the window for a>b and a~b: g3c25>g2c43~10
Combine
&
and: tue&g2c75@15
/
or: sky/fake
!
not: 2609&!g1
,
any of, for weekdays, markers and motifs: tue,thu, sky,fake, m3537,m43
x
at the end: collapse unrelated weeks: dawn&x
v250916,250923
compare days side by side, shared messages linked; Shift+Enter compares the matches
.2501
jump without filtering
